name: thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR
author: thetechspert

sections.description:
thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR helps WordPress website owners create and manage a UK Privacy Policy, cookie banner, consent records, complaints and data request processes from inside WordPress.

For developers and site owners looking for a UK GDPR WordPress plugin, it combines UK Privacy Policy wording, cookie consent controls, data request forms and basic records in one dashboard.

The plugin is designed for UK small businesses, charities, consultants, agencies, ecommerce stores and WordPress website owners who want a practical way to present privacy information clearly and maintain basic records.

With recent and upcoming UK data protection changes, website owners may need clearer privacy information, a data protection complaint route, data request handling, cookie information and records of consent choices. thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR helps you put those essentials in one place.

Features include:

  • Privacy and GDPR Policy page generator
  • Guided setup wizard
  • Cookie banner with visitor preferences
  • Lightweight consent logging
  • Data protection complaint form
  • Subject Access Request / data request form
  • Email opt-out request form
  • Submission logs inside WordPress
  • Snippet examples for forms and collection points
  • Privacy page display modes for hard-coded themes
  • Cookie banner on/off setting
  • Basic colour, font and content settings
  • Optional Use of AI policy section and AI-related data category wording
  • AI disclosure snippets for AI-enabled features and AI-assisted services
  • Built-in anti-spam protection without Google reCAPTCHA

thetechspert Privacy Compliance Tools for UK GDPR is a practical compliance support tool. It does not guarantee legal compliance and should not replace professional legal advice.

Free and Pro

The free version includes the core privacy policy, cookie banner, complaint, data request and opt-out tools.

A Pro version is available for users who need advanced tools such as enhanced exports, advanced cookie script loading, richer records, additional cookie banner positioning, colour and font-size controls, additional snippets and priority support. The Pro version is optional, and the free plugin remains fully usable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from the WordPress plugin directory when available.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. You will be redirected to thetechspert Privacy Tools > Setup Wizard.
  4. Complete the setup steps.
  5. Review the generated Privacy and GDPR Policy page.
  6. Test the complaint, data request and opt-out forms.
  7. Review cookie settings and consent logging.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin guarantee GDPR compliance?

No. The plugin helps website owners create and manage important privacy, cookie, complaint and data request processes, but every business is different and legal advice may still be required.

Does the cookie banner block all scripts automatically?

The free plugin provides a cookie banner and lightweight consent logging. It does not automatically block scripts loaded by other plugins, themes, Google Tag Manager or hard-coded header scripts. Advanced cookie script loading is intended for the Pro version.

Does it keep records?

Yes. The free plugin keeps basic logs of consent choices, complaints, data requests and opt-out submissions. The Pro version is designed to add enhanced records and CSV export options.

Does it use SMTP?

The plugin uses the standard WordPress mail function. For better reliability, we recommend using a trusted SMTP plugin or transactional email service on your WordPress website.

What are the privacy page display modes?

The plugin includes display modes to help the generated privacy page work with different WordPress themes. Theme default uses your normal theme layout. Plugin Default helps create a cleaner plugin-controlled layout where needed. Plugin Standalone provides a simpler standalone layout for themes that make the page difficult to display correctly.

Can I turn off the cookie banner?

Yes. The cookie banner can be turned on or off from the plugin settings.

Does the plugin include anti-spam protection?

Yes. Version 1.0.13 adds built-in anti-spam protection for the complaint, data request and email opt-out forms. It can use a hidden honeypot field, a simple maths question and a minimum submission time check without relying on Google reCAPTCHA or external scripts.

Can I turn off the anti-spam checks?

Yes. Anti-spam protection can be managed from the plugin settings. You can enable or disable the built-in protection and choose which checks to use.

Can I add information about the use of AI?

Yes. Version 1.0.15 adds an optional Use of AI section. You can enable it from the dashboard, edit the wording so it reflects how your website or business actually uses AI, and optionally include AI-related prompts, uploads or interaction data in the data categories section. AI disclosure snippets are also included for use beside AI-enabled website features.

Can the plugin use my website theme font?

Yes. The frontend font can be set to inherit the active theme font, or you can choose from several common font families in the plugin dashboard. The setting applies to the policy area, plugin forms, cookie banner and plugin buttons.

Is there a paid version?

Yes. A Pro version is available from https://privacytools.uk/product/pro/ for users who need advanced tools such as enhanced exports, advanced cookie script loading, richer records, additional cookie banner positioning, colour and font-size controls, additional snippets and priority support.

Do I need the free plugin installed before using Pro?

Yes. The Pro version is designed as an add-on for the free plugin. Please install and activate the free plugin before installing the Pro version.

Can visitors reopen cookie preferences?

Yes. When the cookie banner is enabled, the generated Privacy and GDPR Policy page includes a Change cookie settings button so visitors can reopen the banner and update their preferences.

Can I use one Pro licence on multiple websites?

No. One Pro licence is for one WordPress website only.
sections.changelog:
1.0.16

  • Reissued the 1.0.15 release as 1.0.16 to retrigger WordPress.org release processing after correcting the duplicate readme filename in SVN.

1.0.15

  • Added an optional Use of AI section with editable policy wording.
  • Added an AI-related data category for prompts, uploads and interaction data.
  • Added AI feature input and AI-assisted service snippet examples.
  • Added a frontend font selector, including a theme-font option, for policy content, forms, cookie banner and plugin buttons.
  • Added a dashboard control for button text colour.
  • Updated WordPress compatibility metadata to Tested up to 7.1.
  • Improved WordPress Plugin Directory wording and discovery tags around UK GDPR, privacy policy, cookie banner, cookie consent and data requests.
  • Updated Pro wording to mention advanced cookie banner positioning, colour and font-size controls.

1.0.14

  • Fixed the setup wizard so the cookie banner remains enabled by default after initial setup.
  • Changed the default cookie banner colours for new installs to a white background with black text.
  • Updated Pro information to mention additional cookie banner design controls, including position, colours and font sizes.

1.0.13

  • Added English UK language files and plugin textdomain loading support.
  • Added an unselected tab text colour setting for generated policy page tabs.
  • Added built-in anti-spam protection for complaint, data request and opt-out forms.
  • Added honeypot, simple maths question and minimum submission time checks.
  • Added anti-spam settings to the main plugin settings page.

Earlier releases

See CHANGELOG.md in the plugin package for the full release history.
